<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The file `winscp_default_configuration.ini` is a standard WinSCP configuration file containing only INI-style settings for the application's interface behavior. It contains no executable code, no network requests, no file operations beyond path references, and no obfuscated or encoded content. The three entries (RandomSeedFile, DDTemporaryDirectory, PuttyPath) are all legitimate WinSCP configuration options. The PuttyPath value uses environment variable expansion (`%WINSCP_PATH%`) which is standard Windows INI syntax for portable application paths. Nothing in this file deviates from expected packaging or application behavior.
</details>
